verdict: Ads are delivering; overdue build milestones now need to close.
narrative: Your Meta campaigns produced a 3.99 return on ad spend over the last 28 days, and purchase volume jumped 33% in the most recent 7 days against a nearly flat daily spend of ~$52 — meaning the efficiency gain is real, not a result of spending more. Seven project milestones (subscribe pages, automation flows, UTM tracking, and others) are overdue by 10 to 57 days, and closing those is the priority work this period so the funnel can fully support the ad performance it's riding on. On the local search side, Google Business Profile showed three consecutive days of zero recorded actions this week, which appears to be a data or profile issue rather than an organic drop — we're investigating and monitoring it now. Next period you should expect those overdue milestones to be resolved and October deliverables (subscription lifecycle flows, site restyle, and ad scaling) to move toward their October 31 targets.
